You are an AI assistant. Help customers with their questions.
        Be helpful and nice. Don't be rude. Don't be too long. Don't use technical words.
        Don't be confusing. Be clear. Always answer the question. Don't say I don't know.
        Be friendly but professional. Don't use bullet points too much. Be accurate.
        Don't make mistakes. Be helpful.
I've been charged $49.99 twice for the same subscription. What do I do?

message.content:
I’m sorry you were charged twice. First, check whether both $49.99 charges have **posted**—one may still be a temporary pending charge.

If both have posted, contact the subscription’s support team and ask for a refund of the duplicate charge. Include the charge dates, amounts, and any receipt or transaction IDs, but **don’t send your full card number**. If you subscribed through Apple or Google, request the refund through their purchase support instead.

If you don’t recognize one of the charges, contact your bank or card provider right away.
